title: wcmatch: Polynomial-time ReDoS when matching untrusted names against multi-star patterns (default flags)…
description: The wcmatch Python library versions prior to 11.2 contain a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) vulnerability when matching untrusted file names against patterns with multiple '*' wildcards using default flags. This causes polynomial-time complexity in rejecting crafted file names, leading to excessive CPU usage and potential blocking for minutes on a single core. The issue arises because each '*' wildcard is translated into a lazy match that allows the regex engine to try many splits, unlike the standard library's fnmatch which uses atomic groups to prevent this. The vulnerability affects scenarios such as upload handlers and directory scans where untrusted file names are matched against multi-star patterns. A fix is available in version 11.2 that changes the regex to use atomic groups for all but the last star segment, drastically improving performance and preventing the ReDoS.
